explainer.intro: Put the borrowing power of your ETH or BTC to work. Juicer manages a PRIME looping strategy and compounds eligible earnings into the asset you deposit.
explainer.deposit.label: Deposit
explainer.earn.label: Earn
explainer.withdraw.label: Withdraw
explainer.deposit.description: Your asset is supplied to the money market and you receive vault shares. Synthetic backing protects this collateral position while borrowed HOLLAR goes to work in a separate PRIME loop.
explainer.deposit.note: You keep exposure to your deposited asset. Paying with another asset swaps it into the deposit asset first; keepers build the PRIME position gradually.
explainer.earn.description: Juicer converts harvested yield into your deposited asset. After the protocol harvest share and vault borrowing interest, the remainder compounds into your balance.
explainer.earn.note: Keepers handle harvesting, rebalancing and automatic debt reduction at safety thresholds. Yield awaiting harvest is shown separately as pending yield.
explainer.withdraw.description: Request a full or partial withdrawal. Your shares stay invested during the cooldown, then settle in parts. Claim available payouts from Withdrawals, with an optional swap into another supported asset.
explainer.withdraw.note: Requests cannot be cancelled. The cooldown is the earliest an unwind can start; shared settlement and liquidity affect the final timing.
explainer.risk: Returns vary. Strategy shortfalls or pauses can delay withdrawals; principal protection depends on correct configuration and timely maintenance.
strategy.name: Juicer
strategy.title: Strategy overview
strategy.apyEstimate: Estimated annual return at current rates and target borrowing, after borrowing interest and the protocol harvest share.
Actual returns depend on deployment and market conditions. Swap fees, slippage and conversion delays are excluded.
Pending yield is an estimate until harvested and converted into your deposited asset.
strategy.deploymentDescription: Each vault pools new deposits and harvested earnings that are ready to put to work.
Keepers borrow and trade gradually within the strategy’s price limits. This shows vault-wide progress, not your position in a deposit queue.
Withdrawal progress is shown separately under Withdrawals.
positions.title: My positions
positions.col.netApy.deployed: Borrowing at {{ value, number(maximumFractionDigits: 0) }}% of target
positions.accruingTooltip: Estimated yield since the last harvest: {{ amount }}. It compounds automatically when harvested; the amount may change before conversion.
positions.harvest.reserve.label: Waiting for reserves
positions.harvest.reserve.description: Harvesting resumes once the strategy covers a ${{gap, number(maximumFractionDigits: 2)}} gap in its backing and reserves, plus at least ${{minimum, number(maximumFractionDigits: 2)}} of harvestable yield. These are shared strategy requirements, not charges deducted from your balance.
positions.harvest.minimum.label: Below harvest minimum
positions.harvest.minimum.description: The surplus above principal, withdrawals and execution reserves is below the strategy-wide harvest minimum of ${{minimum, number(maximumFractionDigits: 2)}}.
positions.harvest.capacity.label: Waiting for harvest capacity
positions.harvest.capacity.description: The strategy has no harvest capacity under its current safety limits. Your pending amount is not yet available to compound.
positions.harvest.awaiting.label: Awaiting harvest
positions.harvest.awaiting.description: Yield is available to harvest. Keepers check trade limits and market conditions before converting it and adding it to your balance.
positions.harvest.paused.label: Harvest paused
positions.harvest.paused.description: Harvesting resumes when the vault and shared strategy are active again.
positions.harvest.accounting.label: Awaiting settlement
positions.harvest.accounting.description: The strategy is allocating proceeds and costs before the next harvest.
positions.harvest.service.label: Servicing borrowing interest
positions.harvest.service.description: The vault must service borrowing interest before harvesting can continue.
positions.harvest.unavailable.label: Harvest status unavailable
positions.harvest.unavailable.descriptio: Harvest status could not be refreshed. Your pending yield remains an estimate; try again after the connection recovers.
positions.readFailed: Some position or withdrawal data could not be refreshed. Amounts may be out of date. Try again after the connection recovers.

withdrawals.eta.label: Est. claimable in

withdrawals.claim.label: Claim available payouts for {{symbol}} withdrawal
withdrawals.claim.title: Claim withdrawal

deposit.benefit.managedBorrowingDescript: Keepers rebalance borrowing and reduce PRIME exposure when safety thresholds are reached.
deposit.alert.paused: This vault is temporarily not accepting new deposits.
deposit.alert.deficit: New deposits are paused while the strategy restores backing. Existing positions remain recorded; withdrawal availability is shown separately.
deposit.alert.delever: Deposits are paused while the vault reduces borrowing after a price move. They resume once the adjustment completes and deposit conditions are met.
deposit.alert.deploying: Deposits are paused while the strategy processes funds. Check the vault status again once this completes.
deposit.alert.full: The vault has reached its cap. New deposits are not accepted until capacity becomes available.
deposit.alert.notReady: This vault is not open for deposits yet.
deposit.alert.unavailable: The vault status could not be loaded, so deposits are disabled. Try again after the connection recovers.
deposit.modal.title: Deposit to {{ name }}
deposit.executionDescription: Once confirmed, your deposit supplies collateral and you receive vault shares.
Keepers put its borrowing capacity to work gradually; the deposit itself makes no strategy trade.
When paying with another asset, the transaction buys and deposits the quoted collateral amount. Any unspent amount stays in your wallet.
If token approval is needed, you will confirm it before the deposit or together with it.
deposit.toast.success: {{ amount }} deposited; strategy deployment follows gradually
deposit.failed: The deposit could not complete. Check your balance and the current vault status, then retry. If the approval step went through, it stays valid for your next attempt.
deposit.failed.filled: Other deposits filled the vault before yours landed, so nothing was deposited.
deposit.review.title: Deposit into {{ name }}
deposit.swap.deposit.tooltip: The exact {{ symbol }} bought and deposited in one transaction. If the price moves too far first, nothing happens and you can try again.
deposit.swap.deposit.tooltip.exact: The swap is 1:1, so your full amount is deposited. Your trade limit doesn't apply.
deposit.swap.unavailable: No {{ symbolIn }} to {{ symbol }} quote is available right now. Try another amount, or deposit {{ symbol }} directly.
deposit.swap.failed: Nothing was deposited, and your {{ symbol }} stays in your wallet, apart from any network fee. Check your balances and the current vault status, then retry.
deposit.fee.unavailable: The network fee for this deposit can't be estimated right now, so it can't be paid in {{ symbol }}. Try again shortly.
deposit.swap.failed.filled: Other deposits filled the vault before yours landed, so nothing was bought or deposited.

withdraw.reserveShort: This withdrawal needs additional funding before it can fully settle. Your unpaid claim remains recorded; timing depends on funding and settlement.
withdraw.ack: This request cannot be cancelled. The unwind can begin after the {{duration}} cooldown; claim payouts from Withdrawals as they become available. Additional yield may arrive in HOLLAR.
withdraw.review.title: Request withdrawal

withdraw.review.max: Requesting your whole position, currently estimated at {{ amount }}, including funded earnings added before confirmation. This request cannot be cancelled.

transfer.previewOnlyDescription: Preview only — transfers are not connected yet. This sends position shares, not the underlying asset.
transfer.paused: The vault is paused. Positions can't be sent until it resumes.
